Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role We are developing advanced autonomous systems that need to fly close to the ground, over varied terrain and through cluttered environments such as forests and built-up areas, where there is very little margin for error. Even a carefully prepared flight plan must be backed by onboard sensing, ready to react to terrain variations and unexpected obstacles. We are building this capability and exploring hybrid approaches that combine planning and real-time reaction. Your mission The goal of this internship is to explore, develop and evaluate terrain-following and collision-avoidance methods based primarily on onbo
